properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KINO kye nsiima-ennyo
Bwe nkirowoozaako,
-Okusembera-okumpi
N'okufa nga sitya.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Buli kiro mmala
Ebbanga mu kkubo;
Eririntuusa-eyo
Ewaffe mu ggulu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Siriiko kye ntya nze
Mu lugendo luno,
Gye mgenda mu ggulu
Kitange gy'abeera.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Byonna ndibiraba
Bye nasomangako,
-Abatukuvu bonna
Abankulembera.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ne bamalayika
Nga bakuba-ennanga,
Era ne Katonda,
Mukama w'obulamu-.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Namuwammantira
Mu nzikiza-ey'ensi;
Yanzaawula,era
Mu kufa-alimponya.
